name: Joe Rogan
role: American podcaster (The Joe Rogan Experience), comedian and UFC commentator
summary: Podcast host who calls himself socially liberal and a 'bleeding heart liberal' on many issues, while backing gun rights, the police and the military. He has supported universal healthcare, universal basic income, same-sex marriage and drug legalization, and has endorsed candidates across the spectrum (Ron Paul, Bernie Sanders, Donald Trump in 2024). He is sceptical of mainstream positions on COVID vaccines, transgender issues and climate, and critical of foreign military intervention.

notes: His views do not fit a single party: he endorsed Sanders in 2020 and Trump in 2024, then criticised Trump's tariffs, deportations and Iran policy. Many statements are null because he speaks informally and often, and few clear, verifiable statements exist on those topics. Saying he 'supports' police and the military was not taken as support for more funding or authority. His endorsement of Sanders' tax on stock trading was not taken as a general position on taxing the wealthy.
